# shipd_event_webhook (Resource)

An HTTPS endpoint for customer events. Destroy deletes the endpoint and cancels pending deliveries. To configure a new receiver, create the webhook with enabled set to false, rotate the signing secret in shipd, and save it in the receiver’s secret manager before enabling delivery. Terraform state contains the destination URL and omits signing secrets. Use shipd for test sends, delivery history, and redelivery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "shipd_event_webhook" "invoices" {
  environment_id = "your-environment-id"
  name           = "Invoice events"
  url            = "https://receiver.example/webhooks"
  event_types    = ["invoice.paid", "invoice.voided"]
  enabled        = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Owning environment ID. Changing it replaces the webhook.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Set of event types to deliver. Use * to match all event types.
- `name` (String) Display name. Changing the name replaces the webhook.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) HTTPS destination without user information or a fragment. Changing the URL replaces the webhook. Terraform stores the complete URL in plan and state. Use a URL without credentials.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether delivery is enabled. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable webhook ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import shipd_event_webhook.invoices ENVIRONMENT_ID/ENDPOINT_ID
```
